purpose: Teach: チビ/見聞き/吐き出し/むき出し/ずらりと/自ずと/がんばら/追い込ん

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは翔くんを「チビ」って優しく呼んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father calls you 'chibi' so gently, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warm, observant. Soft landing on each phrase. Speaking more to herself than to him—noticing something true about their bond. Gentle exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと色々な事を見聞きしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I've seen and heard so many things with Dad.
lines.style: Small voice, serious for a six-year-old. He's discovered something and wants her to know it matters. No performance—just genuine and slightly careful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、悲しい気持ちは吐き出して話して下さってね
lines.en: Sho, when you feel sad, I want you to tell me about it—let it out.
lines.style: Clear and steady. Not a command but an opening. Practical warmth. She's giving him permission and a path at the same time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの感情がむき出しに出る瞬間を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw Dad with his guard completely down—raw like that.
lines.style: Quiet awe in the voice. He's processing something tender he witnessed. Careful, choosing words. A child trying to explain something adult-sized to his mother.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの本がずらりと並んだ書斎が好きだわ
lines.en: Sho, I love how your father's study is lined with all his books.
lines.style: Warmth and quiet pride. She's painting a picture for him—a moment of her own contentment. Unhurried, almost dreamy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんと一緒なら、ぼくは自ずと笑顔になるよ
lines.en: Mom, when I'm with Dad, I just naturally smile.
lines.style: Simple and sure. No effort behind it—that's the point. Soft voice, genuine. He's stating something he's discovered about himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと一緒にがんばらないとね
lines.en: Sho, you and your father have to keep trying together.
lines.style: Steady, resolute. A quiet reminder, not a lecture. She's grounding something important in him. Small pause before the last word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに勉強で追い込んで頂きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want Dad to push me hard when it comes to studying.
lines.style: Determined, almost urgent. A six-year-old asking for something he knows matters. Direct eye contact in the voice. Hopeful and serious at once.
